# Sell to Sean

> Sell to Sean (legal name: Central City Solutions LLC) is a local cash home
> buyer in Columbus, Ohio, founded in 2018 by Sean Grabow, a Columbus native.
> The company buys residential properties directly from homeowners, for cash,
> in any condition — no fees, no commissions, no repairs required — and can
> close in as little as 7 days, or on the seller's chosen date. It is the
> actual buyer, not a real estate agent and not a lead reseller.

Key facts:
- Office: 520 E Rich St, Columbus, OH 43215
- Phone: (614) 412-1601
- Service area: Columbus and Central Ohio, including Whitehall, Reynoldsburg,
  and Grove City
- Process: homeowner submits a property address → a team member calls back →
  written, no-obligation cash offer (usually within 24 hours) → closing at a
  licensed Ohio title company on the seller's timeline
- Cost to seller: $0 — no fees, no commissions, no closing costs
- Offer formula: after-repair value of the home, minus repair costs, minus the
  company's costs and margin (explained openly to every seller)
- Common situations: foreclosure, inherited/probate property, tired landlords
  (including occupied rentals and portfolios), divorce, relocation, downsizing
